records.source_meaning: A headwind makes sailing difficult, but they should have a tailwind on the route to Ceuta.
records.context: Julio sets Ceuta as the destination. The system explains heading and sail controls, then Rafael can ask about the wind. Julio reassures him and explains what to do if the fleet encounters trouble en route.
records.localization_note: The contrast and qualified reassurance answer Rafael’s concern and preserve the actual wind direction.
